item.title: Former Magazine Model Kanako Kawabata’s Partner Arrested on Suspicion of Murder
item.description: Former “egg” magazine model Kanako Kawabata, credited with popularizing the Japanese slang expression “agepoyo,” was allegedly murdered by her live-in partner, who has been arrested four months after the 36-year-old woman’s death in Tokyo.

item.title: Tokyo Bar Scams Targeting Foreign Tourists Triple as Losses Reach $2.5 Million
item.description: Foreign tourists visiting Tokyo’s notorious Kabukicho entertainment district are increasingly falling victim to fraudulent bars, with complaints of overcharging tripling over the past year and reported financial losses across Shinjuku reaching approximately ¥390 million ($2.5 million).

item.title: TBS Anime Revenue Surges 38% as Overseas Streaming Drives Profit Turnaround
item.description: Japanese broadcaster TBS Television has reported a dramatic turnaround in its anime business, with revenue increasing nearly 38% and gross profit reaching ¥1.175 billion ($7.6 million), thanks largely to strong overseas streaming performance from titles such as The Ramparts of Ice.

item.title: Japan Startup Brain Implant Lets Paralyzed Patients Communicate Through Thoughts
item.description: A Japanese startup is preparing to begin clinical trials of a brain implant that could allow severely paralyzed patients to communicate and operate electronic devices using only their thoughts, with the company hoping to bring the technology to market by 2030.

item.title: Hololive Merchandise Sales Drop 14.5% Following VTuber Graduations
item.description: Hololive production operator Cover Corporation has reported a 14.5% decline in merchandise revenue, with the departures of several VTubers continuing to affect sales, although the company’s increasingly lucrative trading card game business is helping to compensate for the losses.
